summary: Tech is doing the lifting again. The Nasdaq pushed to a fresh record on fresh AI catalysts while the Dow lagged and Treasury yields kept climbing.
market_note: S&P futures up 0.6%, Dow futures flat, oil down 1% to about $90, 10-year yield up to 5.33%.

items.why: Follow-through from Friday's Q3 delivery beat (486,532 vehicles vs about 461,000 expected), plus Musk confirming weekend talks with TSMC on the Terafab chip project.
Extending Friday's 6% rally after Reuters reported Meta will manufacture its custom AI chip, Iris, with BofA reiterating a Buy on the AI infrastructure story.
Melius Research upgraded Microsoft to Buy on Monday, lifting its price target to $665 and calling Nadella's team the adults in charge of AI; Copilot also crossed 30 million paid seats.
No single headline; riding the broader tape as the Nasdaq pushes to a fresh record on the day's AI momentum.
